description: Construction number 969111; the four-digit tactical number 9111 is derived from it. Entered service with 41. PLM Malbork in 1974 and transferred to 3. PLM Poznań in September 1998. Restored by "Grupa Archeo" of 31. Baza Lotnictwa Taktycznego and returned to its plinth in the old flight-line area on 19 August 2016; wears the stylised raven's head of the Krzesiny units on the fin
